title: LLM Model Testing Lab
description: Build a tiny GPT and test it, then evaluate a real open-weights LLM (SmolLM2-135M): knowledge, calibration, instruction following, safety, bias, memorisation and quantization drift, with CI quality gates. No API key needed.
